desc: 大容量分区收纳、防泼水面料、透气背负，通勤旅行一包搞定
name: 商务通勤大容量防水双肩包款

shots.intent: 三秒立住「通勤、旅行、上学多场合+大容量防水」的核心卖点，赢得停留与点击。
shots.textZone: top 40% copy zone: thin-bordered kicker box, oversized headline, charcoal pill, and three charcoal circle labels

shots.intent: 一屏扫清「能否定型、能否装电脑、背板闷不闷、能否挂行李箱」的功能疑问。
shots.textZone: four evenly spaced icon-and-label groups across the middle band

shots.intent: 让买家把包代入自己的日常——上班通勤、短途旅行、休闲出行，完成自我投射。
shots.textZone: top strip: bold headline with thin divider and one short subtitle line

shots.intent: 用编号分区图证明「主袋+组合袋+前袋+侧袋」的收纳逻辑，消除装不下、找不到的疑虑。
shots.textZone: centered headline with divider and subhead; one numbered badge and short label per grid cell

shots.intent: 放大「下雨天包会湿」的痛点，用泼水成珠的微距实证面料防泼溅，并带出耐磨抗撕等性能。
shots.textZone: top headline strip; bottom row of four small circle labels

shots.intent: 逐项证明背垫、肩带、锁扣的舒适与防盗设计，支撑久背不累的安全感。
shots.textZone: centered headline with divider and subhead; bold subhead plus one short supporting line beside each crop

shots.intent: 用尺寸标注线与参数清单回答「多大、装得下吗」，消除尺码疑虑。
shots.textZone: headline top center; dimension lines with two value labels; lower area spec list of four generic field rows with short sample values standing in for the real specs to be swapped in later

shots.intent: 微距特写证明拉链、五金、车缝与底部加固的做工，坐实品质感。
shots.textZone: small label beside each macro crop

shots.intent: 框线主推位加色卡行，让买家一眼锁定心仪配色，减少选择犹豫。
shots.textZone: diagonal corner ribbon on the main frame; one short label under each thumbnail

shots.intent: 以干净收口位与行动按钮完成最后转化引导，不编造任何优惠信息。
shots.textZone: headline above the product; solid rounded CTA button below

style.backgroundSystem: alternating full-width flat bands of pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F0F0F0; hero opens on a split #FFFFFF/#F0F0F0 wall with optional muted green #7C9A6D botanical shadow decor and a matte white round podium
style.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke, plus black #2D2D2D circular numbered badges for callouts
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows only, neutral color temperature; lower-key directional light reserved for the pain-point panel only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal monochrome ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F0F0F0 band backgrounds, near-black text #1A1A1A, charcoal accent #2D2D2D, optional muted green #7C9A6D botanical shadow decor on the hero only; neutral temperature; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin divider line; consistent thin-line rounded-square outline icons and black circular numbered badges; bright even high-key studio lighting with soft contact shadows; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, centered and upright placement; clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand logos, watermarks or QR codes
style.presentationRules: product rendered near-black on light bands, centered and upright, stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across variant and closing shots; callouts always via numbered badges or short labels
style.surfaceSystem: matte white round podium and seamless flat band backgrounds; no textured or reflective surfaces
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif (CJK-safe) headlines with a thin divider underline; short labels only, no dense body text
